title: Cosmic Otter Eclipse
description: A brown otter floats in the center of the image, wearing a purple starry cape and holding a glowing orb with a ring of fire. Behind it is a large solar eclipse with a fiery orange corona, set against a swirling purple and green cosmic sky with stars and meteors. Below, stone stairs lead upward through lush green foliage with yellow flowers, pink roses, grapes, white feathers, and a small blue sign reading 'OTTER SHIT' next to a potted plant.
